result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, and oldest first within each priority. The full suite passes offline (607 tests, 0 failures).

The change is in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/SupportTicketStore.java`, in `listOpenInRegion` (around line 81). I reused the same `CASE` expression and `OLDEST_FIRST` ordering that `listOpenOfSalesRep` already uses, and updated the doc comment to match. Closed tickets and other regions are still filtered out as before. Nothing is committed.
